title: Microsoft Teams: voice phishing detection for external calls
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts and voice phishing policy command are supported. It correctly distinguishes the parameter's default from the unpublished rollout default and separates detection from user reporting. The call-reporting paragraph should carry the documented client and mailbox qualifications.

claims.claim: In organisations with Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 or Defender XDR, users can report suspicious calls when Report call is enabled.

claims.fix: Add after the reporting prerequisites: 'The User reported settings page documents call reporting on the Teams desktop client and Web App, and requires users to have an online Teams mailbox.'
